question: The intestinal absorption of iron is more effective:

options.opa: In the form of ferric ion.
options.opb: In the form of heme group.
options.opd: If there are oxalates in digestive light.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Iron in the form of heme group" -> "more effectively absorbed in the intestines" -> 80% CHAIN: "Iron in the form of ferric ion" -> "requires conversion to ferrous ion for absorption" -> "less effective absorption compared to heme iron" -> 70% CHAIN: "Iron absorbed via the transferrin membrane transporter" -> "facilitates efficient uptake of iron into cells" -> 85% CHAIN: "Presence of oxalates in the digestive tract" -> "can bind to iron and inhibit absorption" -> "reduced effectiveness of iron absorption" -> 80%
